def transform(grid):
    """Keep cells marked in both panels across the full-width divider."""
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
                   if row and all(value == row[0] and value != 0 for value in row))
    upper = grid[:divider]
    lower = grid[divider + 1:]
    if len(upper) != len(lower):
        raise ValueError("panels must have equal height")
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0
             for a, b in zip(top, bottom)]
            for top, bottom in zip(upper, lower)]
